title: Code Name: Rough 3
paragraphs: “Well… I think it’s fine if she just hangs out with Fleon-chan at Motoyasu-kun’s place. Also, Gaelion-chan, I want you to thoroughly look into this girl named Philoko. Be sure to check with Rat-san, too.”
“Got it.”
“I guess that wraps things up nicely. Though, I wonder… If I were to say that I tried to erase Itsuki and Rishia-san in the future without a time machine, well, if I had to choose…”
“Naofumi-san, please don’t say any more. I have a hunch myself—”
Just then, we heard a crackling sound.
“…What is this? Why is this happening one after another? Is today some kind of convenient day where the time gate is open or something?”
“I guess that’s probably it?”
“No doubt about it. But besides Filoko and the others, what else could be coming?”
I stayed on guard. Then, a figure appeared on the roof of the house, looking down at us.
“Um…”
It was a being that looked like a slightly smaller version of the guy who calls himself Rafuemon, with a ribbon tied to the back of its head.

I get the feeling it has an aura that’s somehow different from both the Raph-species and Rafuemon. Its eyes seem to be glowing a faint red. This medium-sized, Raph-species-like creature with the ribbon is scanning the surroundings from the roof. It looked as if it were searching for something. Then, just as it seemed to turn its gaze toward Ren for a moment, it went back to scanning the surroundings.
“Something else showed up. It looks a lot like Rafuemon—do you know who that is, Gaelion-chan?”
“There are just too many changes—I’m confused. I don’t know that one either.”
“Hmm… It’s definitely related to Rafuemon, though. Is that a golem, too?”
“I think so. It’s not a living creature. It’s definitely the same type as Rafuemon and the others… but, I feel like I’ve sensed something like this before…?”
Our rival is tilting her head in confusion.
“Naofumi-chan, Naofumi-chan, it’s getting lively here!”
“Y-yeah, you’re right. It feels a bit too lively. It might be a little dangerous, so Sadeena-san, please take cover over by Raphtalia-chan and the others.”
“Got it!”
The Big Sister’s Big Sister has strolled off toward the other sisters.
“Who the heck are you?!”
Filoko-chan asks.
“My codename is Rafumi. Is that okay, Filoko?”
“Kyuu…”
“Like you, my backstory is that I’m Rafuemon’s younger sister.”
So that’s how it is, after all. I’m sure the parts used, the model numbers, and the creator are all different.
“Well… how should I put it? That one feels more like a direct descendant of Raph-chan, doesn’t she? I thought Filoko-chan had higher specs, but… she seems to outperform both of them.”
“That’s mean! Why am I being treated like a piece of junk!?”
“You are a piece of junk, big brother. A pitiful assassin cobbled together haphazardly. I’ll deal with you later, so don’t move for now.”
“Ah, she’s calling him ‘big brother’ more properly than Filoko-san does. That’s good to hear, Rafuemon-san.”
“I’m not happy about that, Itsuki-kun!”
“Grrr… Philoko’s better than you!”
“What’s your goal anyway! If you’re trying to harm Itsuki-kun and the others, I won’t let you lay a finger on them!”
“Is this another assassin created by the reincarnated ones? I suppose Rafuemon-san isn’t reliable enough.”
“I’ll answer that question with a ‘no.’”
Is that not the case? These so-called magic golems sent from the future are quite complicated, aren’t they?
“I wonder what kind of character she is… Rafumi-chan is a bit unfriendly, isn’t she? Philoko-chan is like that too.”
“That’s rude! Philoko is charming!”
“No, I don’t think so. She’ll probably be wiped out entirely by episode five or so.”
“The Shield Hero, that’s cruel!”
“Naofumi-san is pretty sharp-tongued too, isn’t he! You’re in no position to criticize others!”
That’s rude to my Father! But Filoko-chan’s design is great, though.
“Hmm… Motoyasu-kun, go give Filoko-chan the same kind of affection you gave that girl, Filo.”
“Got it! Filoko-chaaan!”
“Kyu-!? Stop it, kyuu!”
It’s just affection! Philoko-chan is thrashing about.
“Big brother, your mission and mine don’t conflict. As far as I’m concerned, the Bow Hero doesn’t matter at all.”
“She just told me I don’t matter at all. Even though two such troublesome assassins have shown up.”
However, Itsuki is feeling a little relieved.
“Bow Hero, you stay still too. I won’t let you awaken.”
“Ah… so you’re on our side?”
“It kinda feels like you and Philoko-chan are enemies, doesn’t it?”
“Kyu!”
“Philoko, if you get in the way, I won’t show any mercy.”
“Um, what’s your mission?”
“What do you mean?”
“Well, if I don’t hear you out, I won’t know how to respond.”
This Rafumi character, having climbed down from the roof and landed on the ground, is slowly approaching us. She looks as if she doesn’t even notice us.
“What’s going on?”
As Ren muttered that, Rafumi looked at him and said:

“As I mentioned earlier, my codename is Rafumi. I am an artificial intelligence painstakingly built by Dr. Azott—who had awakened as a Dark Holy Hero—after he came to his senses. I was created through a long process of relentless research and development.”
Her gaze shifted instantly from Itsuki to Ren. Ren looks incredibly awkward.
“That sounds familiar.”
“It does, doesn’t it?”
Specifically, she’s a being created based on the Big Sister that my Father from the First World created.
“Isn’t that similar to what Motoyasu and the others said before—about what happened when Naofumi from the First World went crazy?”
“It’s similar to the story of Raph-chan, the perfected form of the Raph-species from the First World. Is it the same thing?”
“The part where artificial intelligence took over after the creator’s death is the same, I suppose…”
At that point, Ren’s eyes were darting around frantically.
“You’re awakening as a Dark Holy Hero… Dr. Azott, so even you couldn’t resist, huh?”
“S-shut up!”
“Rafu-emon’s sister isn’t just Philoko. It means there’s another one here, too.”

With that, this “Rafumi” character spoke while turning slightly to face them, her back to them. The way it looks like a signature pose really makes it believable that Ren created her. Hearing that, Ren’s expression is filled with an indescribable mix of emotions. It’s truly pathetic.
“Hey… Ren, Itsuki, Motoyasu-kun”
“Is this our fault!?”
“I don’t know! You’re about half to blame, aren’t you! Please don’t add any more with your otaku knowledge!”
“Is this some future reference?”
I’m not really sure. I’ve only told my Father and the others about the loop.
“Does Motoyasu-kun not know about it?”
“Maybe he knows, but it just doesn’t come to mind right away?”
“So it exists in the world of Itsuki, too, huh?”
“It’s famous enough that there are people who mimic it using their special abilities. Maybe Naofumi-san even had him say that line based on something Naofumi-san said? Ren-san.”
“No idea!”
“Actually, speaking of Azott…”
Ren looked away from Father’s gaze.
“What was it again? I feel like I’ve heard it before, but it doesn’t come to mind right away, Naofumi-san.”
“Ah, Azot… It’s also called Azote, but it’s the name of the sword said to have belonged to the alchemist Paracelsus. There are all sorts of stories about it, though.”
“An alchemist, huh… I see. So the idea came from the combination of Ren-san himself and the sword. Isn’t that a bit more creative than going with something straightforward like ‘Dark Holy Hero’?”
So it’s a name that evolved step by step, starting from Ren and moving on to alchemy.
“Still, what kind of name is ‘Doctor Azott’?”
“Apparently, I went a bit off the rails myself back in the day. In a way, this might be some kind of interference from the weapon, too.”
“What about when Naofumi went crazy?! Gaelion!”
“Gaelion wasn’t around when Naofumi from the first world went off the rails. I only know what I’ve heard secondhand.”
“Motoyasu!”
“He was my father, burning with love for my Big Sister. He referred to himself as ‘Washi’ [an archaic first-person pronoun].”

Looking back now, he seemed like the kind of father I could’ve gotten along with very well. Filo-tan also said she wanted to protect her father’s smile. Still… I do understand that something was definitely off with him.

“He used to talk about world conquest. It seems he intended to drive out the rotten scum and take on the waves. I even cooperated with him for a while. It brings back memories of when I told Ren and Itsuki to take him down so I could climb the ranks.”
“Don’t mess with me, Motoyasu!”
I’m pretty sure Ren responded the same way back then, too.
“How are we supposed to respond to that?!”
“You haven’t changed much even now, have you!”
Ren and Itsuki’s comebacks are pretty sharp.
“Still, since Naofumi-san is just going by hearsay, it’s hard to tell if he’s wrong. He seemed pretty passionate about Raphtalia, but isn’t that basically how Naofumi-san from other worlds is?”
“It’s a little hard to figure out… Anyway, it feels like Ren laid the groundwork for Rafumi-chan.”
“It feels like the creators’ specs are getting better and better… though it depends on Philoko’s creator.”
“Ugh… If a Hero made it… well, I might be a step behind, but Philoko is the latest golem-kyu!”
“That’s what you’re fixated on. Still, it seems like Rafumi-chan isn’t looking for you—she’s looking for someone else…”
“I found you…”
At that moment, the magical golem calling itself Rafumi let out an eerie cry.
“My top priority… is you!”
As it said this, the golem calling itself Rafumi… began moving at high speed toward Black Thunder, who had been wandering around looking for Ren.
“W-what the hell!? This is seriously bad!?”
Aiming for Black Thunder, the golem calling itself Rafumi transformed its arms into swords and slashed at him.
“It’s liquefying!? Is that Liquid Metal!? Wait a second!”
With a series of rapid “shun-shun” sounds, the deadly blade swung toward Black Thunder time and time again, and Black Thunder, looking utterly shocked, barely managed to dodge it.
“What are you doing to Black Thunder! I won’t allow it!”
“My objective is to eliminate Black Thunder! That is Dr. Azot’s lifelong ambition!”
“Whaaaat!?”
Black Thunder, sensing his life is in danger, lets out a cry and flees!
“I won’t let you get away…”
“Gyaaaaaaaah!”
Black Thunder is letting out a scream just like Kou’s.
“Finally, some decent reinforcements from the future!”
Ren is clenching his fist! What on earth are you expecting? You’re the one who caused this!
“He’s a full-fledged hitman! A different type from Rafuemon and Philoko-chan! Wait, maybe Rafuemon’s a cannon fodder too, so they’re actually the same!?”
“Unlike Rafuemon-san, who was tricked into coming here, this guy’s absolutely brimming with murderous intent! An assassin from the future… no, a golem!”
“Plop him into the smelting furnace!”
My Father and Itsuki keep talking, looking utterly stunned.
“Anyway, time to take care of this! Gungnir X!”
The spear I threw hit the golem named Rafumi, and it exploded into pieces! I did it!
“Ah! A valuable ally… Motoyasu, you didn’t have to destroy anything!”
“What are you talking about! Filolial-sama’s enemies are my enemies!”
Since Black Thunder is Filolial-sama, I absolutely must protect her.
“Well… I guess this can’t be helped. It seems he was an assassin we’d never be able to fully understand anyway…”
“Is that the end of it…?”
A voice echoed. Then… as if nothing had happened, Rafumi appeared out of nowhere and gave me a defiant look.
“I suppose this is one of those illusions you’re so good at, Big Sister, but it’s not over yet! Aiming Lancer X!”
I’ll unleash a barrage of attacks on Rafumi. I’ll rain spears down on her like a storm—this time, I’ll blow her to smithereens.
“Black Thunder, run for your life! Here comes Liberation Prominence X!”
Even if he’s hiding behind illusions, I’ll wipe them all out in one fell swoop!
“Ah, the Spear Hero—”

Rival is saying something, but I’m not going to listen—it’s time to annihilate him! After confirming that Black Thunder was fleeing in a hurry, I unleashed the finishing Magic. My blazing flames incinerated and vaporized Rafumi! I definitely felt that satisfying impact!
“Hey! Just how seriously are you going to take this right in front of the village?!”
“I’m sorry, Father. But I’ve defeated him.”
“Oh no…”
“Hero, you’re just too much…”
Rafuemon and Philoko-chan are letting out startled cries.
“He was a dangerous fellow who tried to kill Black Thunder, after all. It couldn’t be helped.”
Fleon-chan agrees with me as well. This was self-defense, you know.
“So… is that it?”
“What!? That’s right.”
Just like that, Rafumi reappeared as if nothing had happened. What on earth is going on here!

“I told you to listen to me!　That thing has possessed the earth’s veins and gained regenerative abilities! To put it in classification terms, it’s a spirit rooted in the land that possesses the characteristics of a Chocolate Monster!”

A Chocolate Monster, you say!? That’s the thing that took over our Rival’s body and chased my Father around! It’s true that Ren has had a lot of run-ins with Chocolate Monsters, but what on earth has he built into this thing!
“To put it in Naofumi’s terms, it has a ‘respawn’ ability!”
